summary: 4 documents were examined (Identity Card, Salary Slip, Loan Application Form, Bank Statement). The system recorded 3 potential manipulation hypotheses, 5 detected inconsistencies and 9 observations. Review priority: HIGH. Fields with converging evidence of alteration: Salary Slip - Net pay; Loan Application Form - Monthly net income; Bank Statement - Closing balance. Cross-document conflicts: Date of birth mismatch: Loan Application Form says '14/03/1994', Identity Card says '14/03/1996'; Monthly net income mismatch: Loan Application Form says '95,000', Bank Statement says '45,200'; Monthly net income mismatch: Salary Slip says '95,200', Bank Statement says '45,200'. The applicant's stated income (95,000) agrees with the payslip Net Pay (95,200), but that payslip value is itself under suspicion, so this agreement is not treated as independent corroboration. All findings are indicators for human review. None of them is a determination of fraud.
reasoning_notes: The applicant's stated income (95,000) agrees with the payslip Net Pay (95,200), but that payslip value is itself under suspicion, so this agreement is not treated as independent corroboration.

findings.explanation: A signature-like ink stroke was found at (747, 1308, 1053, 1373), but the designated drawn box at (82, 1027, 519, 1164) is empty. A signature outside its box can indicate it was transplanted from another document.

findings.title: Bank Statement: 'Closing balance' uses a font foreign to the rest of the PDF
findings.explanation: The PDF text layer shows '99,220.00' rendered in Times-Roman, while the rest of the document uses helvetica (1.3% of words use this font). Statement generators use a fixed font set; a single foreign-font value is typical of an edit made in a PDF editor.
findings.verification: Obtain the statement directly from the issuing bank.

findings.title: Signature comparison Identity Card vs Loan Application Form: visually consistent (score 0.98)
findings.explanation: Shape correlation of the two signature ink masks is 0.98 (1.0 = identical shape). This is a coarse shape heuristic, not handwriting verification: it cannot authenticate a signer and a high score can also mean a signature was copied.
findings.verification: Forensic handwriting examination if the signature matters to the decision.

findings.title: Salary Slip: Net Pay does not equal Gross minus Deductions
findings.explanation: Gross Earnings - Total Deductions = 45,200, but Net Pay reads 95,200 (difference 50,000). Payroll systems compute Net Pay automatically, so an arithmetic break points to the stated figure having been changed - or an OCR misread.
findings.verification: Recompute from the source system; ask the issuer which figure is correct.

findings.title: Bank Statement: Closing Balance does not match the last running balance
findings.explanation: The transaction table ends at 50,220 but the Closing Balance line reads 99,220 (difference 49,000). Every transaction was re-added; the table itself is internally consistent, so the summary line is the outlier.
findings.verification: Request the statement from the bank.

findings.title: Date of birth mismatch: Loan Application Form says '14/03/1994', Identity Card says '14/03/1996'
findings.explanation: Date of birth is a stable identity attribute; documents for the same person must agree. Similarity score 90.0 (reference document: Identity Card).
findings.verification: Ask the applicant to explain the difference; verify with the issuer of the reference document.

findings.title: Monthly net income mismatch: Loan Application Form says '95,000', Bank Statement says '45,200'
findings.explanation: Income stated on an application should be supported by payslip and bank credit. A mismatch is one of the strongest indicators of an inflated income claim. Similarity score 47.6 (reference document: Bank Statement).

findings.title: Salary Slip: 'Net pay' shows converging signs of alteration (stated value 95,200)
findings.explanation:
4 findings from independent visual/digital (2) and data-consistency (2) checks all concern the same field. Visual traces show how it may have been changed; data conflicts show that the value disagrees with the rest of the submission. Converging, independent signals are much stronger than any single one. Independent sources point to 45,200 as the consistent value (recomputed from components (F-010); Bank Statement (F-014)), whereas the document states 95,200.
- [F-002] Salary Slip: region lacks scanner noise near the value of 'Net pay'
- [F-003] Salary Slip: character size of 'Net pay' differs from aligned values
- [F-010] Salary Slip: Net Pay does not equal Gross minus Deductions
- [F-014] Monthly net income mismatch: Salary Slip says '95,200', Bank Statement says '45,200'

findings.verification: Treat 'Net pay' as unverified. Obtain the original from the issuer and confirm whether 45,200 is correct. This is a hypothesis for human review, not a determination of fraud.
